digest.component_or_area: CI module-size gate and reconciler docs/comments
propositions: The module-size allowlist and ceilings files are orphaned after the gate switched to an absolute 800 LOC cap and must be deleted.
The contract test must assert both the allowlist and ceilings files no longer exist.
Documentation in architecture.md and AGENTS.md must be pruned to remove the retired escape hatch and describe the absolute, admin-locked cap.
Three stale comments incorrectly state route_inbound_probe lives in reconcile.py, but it moved to reconcile_helpers.py and is re-exported.
This work must land after Phase 2a so main's gate no longer reads the deleted files.
The changes are mechanical deletions and doc/comment edits with no runtime logic changes.
